description:
Apotek Pharma is a trusted pharmaceutical company dedicated to delivering quality healthcare and excellent customer service. We are looking for a professional Pharmacy Dispenser to join our friendly team.

**Position: Pharmacy Dispenser**

**Requirements:**
- Minimum Qualification: Diploma in Pharmacy from a reputable institution
- Work experience in a busy pharmacy for at least 2 years
- Age: Should be between 20-35 years
- Language: Fluent in Luganda and English

**Skills & Competencies:**
- Ability to work under minimum supervision
- Good communication skills
- Strong customer relations

**Why Join Us?**
- Professional and friendly team environment
- Deliver quality healthcare services
- Excellent customer service experience
- Be part of a team that cares

**How to Apply:**
Send your CV to: apotekpharma2019@gmail.com

**Deadline for Application:** 14th September 2026

Apotek Pharma - Pharmaceuticals and more. Your Health, Our Priority.
Serving our community with quality, care and trust.
